notInRegister.item: DerivedOverrideEngine computes HALF_LEVEL and ability mod independently of actor-core helpers — _getHalfLevel uses floor(system.level/2); level-split provides getHeroicHalfLevel/getEffectiveHalfLevel. _getAbilityMod recomputes from attributes as fallback. HALF_LEVEL is referenced only by orphan phase-3-feat-definitions.js and the contract, so no live feature uses it.

House-rule (enhanced massive damage) damage-threshold formula: DerivedCalculator adds size twice and keeps feat/Will-base/flat adjustments; ThresholdEngine uses fort+level+size only. Which is intended?
Whether poison damage must be excluded from the half-heroic-level bonus (not in ELEMENTAL_HALF_LEVEL_EXCLUSION_KEYS); not traced

House-rule damage threshold computed independently by DerivedCalculator and ThresholdEngine with different formulas — RAW mode: ThresholdEngine reads system.derived.damageThreshold (single authority). With enableEnhancedMassiveDamage+modifyDamageThresholdFormula, DerivedCalculator stores base(incl. size, feat Will-base, flat/modifier adjustments)+level+size again, while ThresholdEngine.calculateDamageThreshold (used by evaluateThreshold on the live ActorEngine.applyDamage path) returns fort+level+size, ignoring the adjustments. Displayed DT and the DT used for the CT check differ under the house rule.

Readers of one do not see the other (TX-02, still open). Droid removal refunds resale through DroidCustomizationEngine.

notInRegister.item: Skill-feat daily uses keyed on real-world UTC date — todayKey() = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); Force Point receipts record game.time.worldTime for once-per-day contracts (actor-engine.js spendForcePoints). Two incompatible "day" clocks. Note the module register function is never called, so only directly imported helpers run.

Confident Success: second published cap not enforced; counter write not atomic — Canonical text: no more than 3 FP per level and cannot have more FP than gained upon reaching current level; canonical automation note says "Needs ... both Force Point caps". Code enforces maxPerLevel (default 3 when rule missing) and relies on ActorEngine.gainForcePoints max cap; capToLevelStartMax is written by the hook but never read.
Whether the base-6/7 Force Point base persists after a prestige class is removed

scripts/data/force-points.js: write-in-calculation functions with no callers; stale header — The 6 A-02 probe hits are un-awaited actor.setFlag calls inside getForcePointBase / hasPrestigeForcePointBonus (mutation inside a calculation, A-08), reachable only from calculateMaxForcePoints, updateActorForcePoints, initializeActorForcePoints and debug helpers, none of which has a caller. The live export is calculateMaxForcePointsForBuildPlan (read-only). Consequently the persistent prestige markers that FRC and progression read are never written by live code (CR-FRC-02).
Ability modifier for follower Fortitude Defense (hotfix uses CON, NPC sheet display uses max(STR, CON))
Fidelity of MinionManager.MINION_TALENTS paraphrases to printed talents (no source/page)

Minion modules write owner/minion flags directly from a createItem hook; minion talent flags are write-only uncited rule text — MinionManager.applyTalent/removeTalent/_removeStaleFlags call owner.setFlag / minion.setFlag / unsetFlag directly (8 sites), triggered from the follower createItem/deleteItem hooks. The written flags (minionTacticalAbilities, minionTalentRegistry, minionTalentBenefits) have no reader outside the module. MINION_TALENTS holds hand-written rule paraphrases (e.g. Bodyguard II, Fear Me) without book/page.

Three follower defense computations disagree; one installed by monkey-patching DefenseCalculator — The hotfix wraps DefenseCalculator.calculate for followers and rebuilds Fortitude with CON; the NPC sheet helper independently computes Fortitude as 10 + level + max(STR, CON) for display; the deriver applies template bonuses. A follower with STR > CON can show a different Fortitude than the one used by derived/rolls.

Telekinetic Savant/Prodigy text and slot rule hard-coded in a runtime patch, diverging from canonical reference text — The patch replaces picker description/benefit/prerequisite text for two talents with in-code strings and filters the ForcePowerStep Prodigy resolution (suppressProdigyOnlyRetroactiveSlot). The in-code Prodigy text says the extra power must have the [Telekinetic] descriptor and adds a Wisdom-increase clause; the canonical reference (FUCG p.88) says it must be one of the powers affected by Telekinetic Savant. Which text/behavior is authoritative is a rules question; the audit does not decide it.

Hard-coded fallback starting credits by class — When neither content authority nor class/background records yield credits, a fixed table (soldier/scout/scoundrel 3000, jedi/force_adept 1200, noble 4800) is used - a default for missing published data (CLAUDE.md §3).
Custom skill bonus uses half of system.level (custom-skill-roller.js:35) while derived skills use actor-core level-split helpers; aligning changes results for multiclass/nonheroic actors

notInRegister.item: Local skill-total formulas in the rolls domain — getSkillTotal returns a locally rebuilt component total (ability + half level + trained + focus + misc) for useTheForce, and otherwise prefers derived totals with a component fallback. calculateCustomSkillBonus computes ability + 5 trained + 5 focus + floor(system.level/2) + misc. skills.calculateSkillModifier (exported, no importer) omits half level entirely. The derived skill pipeline (actor-core/ABL) is the authority for normal skills.
